en.app.name: VibeLauncher
en.detail.defaultBody: It uses the app's usual data and sign-in. VibeLauncher only opens it; nothing about it is changed.
en.detail.shortcutBroken: The shortcut is missing or outdated.
en.detail.isolationBody: Opened with its own data folder; sign-ins, chats and settings stay separate from other profiles.
en.detail.lostBody: An update probably restarted it on its own, so it's now using the shared settings. Restart it from here to fix that.
en.detail.pendingBody: Finish signing in to {app} in your browser. When the browser asks to open {app}, allow it — the link comes back to this profile.
en.detail.pendingOther: Another profile, “{name}”, is waiting for a sign-in link. Starting a sign-in here will take over.
en.detail.notInstalledBody: Install it from the official website, or point VibeLauncher to it in Settings.
en.sheet.name: Name
en.sheet.argsHint: One per line, passed to the app.
en.sheet.defaultNote: The default profile always runs the app as installed; only its name, color and shortcut can change.
en.delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
en.delete.body: Its shortcut is removed. The app itself isn't touched.
en.delete.data: Also move its data to the trash
en.delete.dataHint: Sign-in, chats and settings in {path}. Leave this off to keep them; creating a profile with the same data folder brings them back.
en.delete.bodyRunning: It's open now, so it quits first. Its shortcut is removed; the app itself isn't touched.
en.login.title: Sign in to {name}
en.login.step2: Sign in there. Your browser opens to finish.
en.login.step3: When the browser asks to open {app}, allow it. The link comes back here.
en.login.expired: Time's up. Start again if you still need to sign in.
en.login.pasteBody: In the browser, copy the link of the “Open {app}” button (or the page's address) and paste it here.
en.login.routingOff: Sign-in links aren't routed through VibeLauncher right now, so they will open in whichever {app} window the system picks. Use “Paste link” below, or turn routing on in Settings.
en.route.title: Which profile should open this link?
en.route.body: Several {app} profiles could have asked for {link}.
en.diag.title: Diagnostics
en.diag.subtitle: Things that can quietly mix profiles up, and one-click fixes.
en.diag.logHint: Where claude:// and codex:// links went, and why. Login codes are never written down.
en.settings.title: Settings
en.settings.linksBody: When you sign in, the browser sends a link (claude:// or codex://) back to the app. VibeLauncher can pass it to the profile that asked for it. It only takes over when you have more than one profile of that app, and gives it back when you turn this off.
en.settings.staggerHint: Profiles restarted together are started this many seconds apart, so their automatic updates don't line up.
en.settings.aboutBody: VibeLauncher opens the official desktop apps with separate profiles. It doesn't modify, copy or redistribute them and never reads your sign-in data.
en.settings.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
en.update.title: Updates
en.update.installing: Installing; VibeLauncher will open again in a moment…
en.update.manualOnly: This copy can't update itself. Download the new version from the website.
en.update.autoHint: When the window opens, VibeLauncher asks GitHub whether a newer version is out. Nothing else is sent.
en.update.betaHint: Also offer beta versions, which come out before each release and may have rough edges. Turning this off keeps the beta you have until a newer release is out.
en.onb.title: Welcome to VibeLauncher
en.onb.body: Keep separate Claude and ChatGPT desktop profiles: work and personal, or one per client. Each has its own sign-in, chats and settings.
en.onb.p1: Uses the official apps you installed — updates keep working.
en.onb.p2: Nothing is copied: each profile signs in on its own.
en.onb.p3: Shortcuts open a profile directly, without this window.
en.empty.title: No app found
en.empty.body: Install Claude or ChatGPT for desktop, then come back. If it's installed somewhere unusual, choose it in Settings.
en.settings.addedAppMissing: Not where it was when you added it
en.detail.addedNotInstalledBody: It was moved or uninstalled since you added it. Remove it in Settings and add it again.
en.appCheck.ok: {app} is an {engine} app: each profile gets a data folder of its own. Sign-in links aren't routed for added apps, so sign in from the profile's own window.
en.appCheck.sandboxed: Flatpak and Snap apps run in a sandbox that keeps their data where the sandbox decides, so VibeLauncher can't give them a folder per profile.
en.appCheck.script: This is a launcher script, and nothing next to it shows what it starts. Choose the program it runs, or the app's menu entry.
en.appCheck.appimage: VibeLauncher couldn't look inside this AppImage (it needs FUSE to mount it). Extract it, or install the app another way, and choose that.
en.appCheck.not-chromium: Only Electron and Chromium apps can run separate profiles: they keep everything in one folder that VibeLauncher can choose. This app isn't one of them.
en.appCheck.built-in: VibeLauncher already knows this app: choose it from the list instead.

zh.app.name: VibeLauncher
zh.detail.defaultBody: 使用应用自己的数据和登录状态。VibeLauncher 只负责打开它，不做任何改动。
zh.detail.shortcutBroken: 快捷方式丢失或已过期。
zh.detail.isolationBody: 使用自己的数据文件夹打开；登录、对话和设置都与其他配置分开。
zh.detail.lostBody: 多半是更新时应用自己重启了，现在用的是共享设置。在这里重新启动即可恢复。
zh.detail.pendingBody: 请在浏览器里完成 {app} 登录。浏览器询问是否打开 {app} 时选择允许，链接会回到这个配置。
zh.detail.pendingOther: 另一个配置“{name}”正在等待登录链接。在这里开始登录会接管它。
zh.detail.notInstalledBody: 请从官网安装，或在设置里告诉 VibeLauncher 它在哪里。
zh.sheet.name: 名称
zh.sheet.defaultNote: 默认配置总是原样运行应用，只能修改名称、颜色和快捷方式。
zh.sheet.badEnv: 第 {n} 行应为 NAME=value 格式。
zh.delete.title: 删除“{name}”？
zh.delete.body: 会移除它的快捷方式，不会动应用本身。
zh.delete.data: 同时把它的数据移到废纸篓
zh.delete.dataHint: {path} 里的登录状态、对话和设置。不勾选则保留；以后新建配置并选同一个数据文件夹即可恢复。
zh.delete.bodyRunning: 它正在运行，会先退出。会移除它的快捷方式，不会动应用本身。
zh.login.title: 登录“{name}”
zh.login.step2: 在 {app} 里登录，浏览器会打开来完成登录。
zh.login.step3: 浏览器询问是否打开 {app} 时选择允许，链接会回到这里。
zh.login.expired: 已超时。如仍需登录，请重新开始。
zh.login.pasteBody: 在浏览器里复制“打开 {app}”按钮的链接（或页面地址），粘贴到这里。
zh.login.routingOff: 现在登录链接不经过 VibeLauncher，会由系统交给任意一个 {app} 窗口。请用下面的“粘贴链接”，或在设置里打开链接转发。
zh.route.title: 用哪个配置打开这个链接？
zh.route.body: 有多个 {app} 配置可能请求了 {link}。
zh.diag.title: 诊断
zh.diag.subtitle: 可能悄悄弄混配置的问题，以及一键修复。
zh.diag.logHint: claude:// 和 codex:// 链接去了哪里、为什么。登录码不会被记录。
zh.settings.title: 设置
zh.settings.linksBody: 登录时，浏览器会把一个链接（claude:// 或 codex://）发回应用。VibeLauncher 可以把它交给发起登录的配置。只有当这个应用有多个配置时才会接管，关闭后会原样交还。
zh.settings.routeIdle: 暂不需要（只有一个配置）
zh.settings.staggerHint: 一起重启的配置会按这个间隔依次启动，避免它们的自动更新撞在一起。
zh.settings.aboutBody: VibeLauncher 用独立配置打开官方桌面应用。它不修改、不复制、不分发这些应用，也从不读取你的登录数据。
zh.settings.notAffiliated: 与 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 无关。
zh.update.title: 更新
zh.update.installing: 正在安装，VibeLauncher 稍后会重新打开…
zh.update.manualOnly: 这个副本无法自行更新，请到项目主页下载新版本。
zh.update.autoHint: 打开窗口时向 GitHub 查询是否有新版本，不会发送其他任何内容。
zh.update.betaHint: 同时接收正式版发布前的测试版，可能还有不完善的地方。关闭后会继续使用当前的测试版，直到有更新的正式版。
zh.onb.title: 欢迎使用 VibeLauncher
zh.onb.body: 为 Claude 和 ChatGPT 桌面版准备多个独立配置：工作和个人分开，或每个客户一个。各自有自己的登录、对话和设置。
zh.onb.p1: 使用你安装的官方应用，更新照常进行。
zh.onb.p2: 不复制任何东西：每个配置各自登录。
zh.onb.p3: 快捷方式直接打开配置，不需要这个窗口。
zh.empty.title: 没有找到应用
zh.empty.body: 请先安装 Claude 或 ChatGPT 桌面版。如果装在特殊位置，可以在设置里手动选择。
zh.detail.addedNotInstalledBody: 添加之后它被移动或卸载了。请在设置里移除它，再重新添加。
zh.appCheck.ok: {app} 是 {engine} 应用，每个配置都有自己的数据文件夹。添加的应用不转交登录链接，请在配置自己的窗口里登录。
zh.appCheck.missing: 这个文件不存在（或已被删除）。
zh.appCheck.sandboxed: Flatpak 和 Snap 应用运行在沙盒里，数据放在哪里由沙盒决定，VibeLauncher 无法给每个配置单独的文件夹。
zh.appCheck.script: 这是一个启动脚本，旁边也看不出它启动的是什么。请选择它实际运行的程序，或这个应用的菜单项。
zh.appCheck.appimage: VibeLauncher 无法查看这个 AppImage 的内容（需要 FUSE 才能挂载）。请先解压，或用其他方式安装这个应用，再选择它。
zh.appCheck.not-chromium: 只有 Electron 和 Chromium 应用能分开配置：它们把所有数据放在一个可以指定的文件夹里。这个应用不属于这两类。
zh.appCheck.built-in: VibeLauncher 已经支持这个应用，请直接在列表里选择。

app-missing: Your profiles can't start until VibeLauncher knows where the app is. Install it, or choose it by hand.
app-not-installed: Nothing to do unless you want to use it.
routing-unsupported: {app} has no menu entry VibeLauncher can stand in for, so sign-in links open its default profile. Use “Paste link” when signing in to another profile.
routing-off: Sign-in links will open whichever {app} window the system picks.
routing-stale: {scheme}:// link handler is out of date
It points at an old copy of VibeLauncher or an old version of the app.
routing-conflict: Another link handler is in the way
routing-ok: Links open in the profile that asked for them.
lost-env: Usually after an update restarted the app by itself; it now reads the shared settings. Restart the profile to fix it.
unknown-instance: A {app} window isn't from any profile
updated: Profiles you open from VibeLauncher get the new version automatically.
updated-running: If the update reopened windows on its own, they may have come back without their profile. Restart your profiles from here to be sure.
simultaneous: {count} {app} profiles started at the same moment
Instances that start together tend to update and restart together, which is when profiles get mixed up. Restarting them a few seconds apart avoids that.
cowork: Claude's Cowork virtual machine belongs to your system account, not to a profile: only one profile at a time can use it.
shortcuts: Some shortcuts are missing or out of date
added-app-missing: It was moved or uninstalled since you added it. Remove it in Settings and add it again.
not-isolated: {app} wrote nothing to this profile's folder ({dir}) after it was opened. Either it didn't start, or it keeps its data in a place of its own, and then this profile shares the account of the usual {app} window.
borrowed-env: It reads that profile's data ({dir}) instead of its own, so things it should find, such as Claude's Code sessions, look missing. This happens when VibeLauncher itself was opened from inside a profile, for example from a Claude Code session. Restart it from VibeLauncher to fix it.

app-missing: 在 VibeLauncher 知道应用位置之前，配置无法启动。请安装它，或手动选择。
routing-unsupported: {app} 没有可供 VibeLauncher 代理的菜单项，登录链接会打开默认配置。登录其他配置时请使用“粘贴链接”。
routing-off: 登录链接会被系统交给任意一个 {app} 窗口。
routing-stale: 它指向旧的 VibeLauncher 或旧版本的应用。
routing-conflict: 有其他链接处理程序挡在前面
routing-ok: 链接会在发起它的配置里打开。
lost-env: 通常是更新时应用自己重启了，现在读的是共享设置。重新启动这个配置即可修复。
unknown-instance: 有一个 {app} 窗口不属于任何配置
updated: 从 VibeLauncher 打开的配置会自动使用新版本。
updated-running: 如果更新时窗口自己重新打开了，它们可能已脱离各自的配置。保险起见，请在这里重新启动这些配置。
simultaneous: {count} 个 {app} 配置在同一时刻启动
同时启动的实例往往会同时更新、同时重启，这正是配置被弄混的时候。错开几秒重新启动可以避免。
cowork: Claude 的 Cowork 虚拟机属于系统账户而不是配置：同一时间只有一个配置能用它。
shortcuts: 有快捷方式丢失或已过期
added-app-missing: 添加之后它被移动或卸载了。请在设置里移除它，再重新添加。
not-isolated: 打开之后，{app} 没有往这个配置的文件夹（{dir}）里写任何东西。要么它没有启动成功，要么它把数据放在自己指定的地方，那样这个配置和 {app} 平常的窗口用的是同一个账号。
borrowed-env: 它读的是那个配置的数据（{dir}），不是自己的，所以本该找到的东西（比如 Claude 的 Code 会话）会显示找不到。这通常是因为 VibeLauncher 本身是从某个配置里面打开的，比如从一个 Claude Code 会话里。从 VibeLauncher 重启它即可修复。
